label: token s: held in memory early in the original phase, then anticipated just before it is copied out
explanation: An s-specific feature. In the original phase it fires from about step 3 onward when s was one of the first two original tokens (first_tok=s rate 0.47 vs 0.06 base). It does not fire at steps 0-1 or when s shows up later in the input. In the delimiter and copy phases it fires in a window that starts up to about 3 steps before s is output and ends on the step where s is fed back as input (out_tok=s rate 0.93, next_out=s rate 0.70). It shuts off soon after s has been copied. The strongest activations (~1.0 of max) come from sequences starting with repeated s (s s s ...), on <DEL> and on the first copied s. Activation is smaller when s sits later in the sequence or further from the current step. Weak activations (bottom quartile) are mostly missed and some come from sequences with no s at all. False positives are mostly the earliest steps of the look-ahead window. Dev: P 0.74, R 0.83, F1 0.78, mass recall 0.93.
